'''Talus Secta''' was the closest [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] point to the [[Talus Station|Talus Space Station]]. It was considered to be an incredibly dangerous area. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], attempting to catch traveling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizers off-guard, kept a vigilant stand point very close by. Learning of the Empire's intentions, the Rebel Alliance responded by stationing guards next to the Talus Seta, hoping to fight off the Empire and make travel safe for the Rebellion and Rebel allies. The ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] between the two factions made traveling to the Talus Secta dangerous for both [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel]] and [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilots]] alike.<ref name="LP" />
